payload.summary: Final Windows Lighthouse distribution shows a mobile-root timing regression that needs a synchronized control
payload.detail: At application head 7cf37b530, three post-remediation Windows runs measured mobile-root LCP 7422-8032ms and TBT 747-1381ms versus pre-head 6c0e759 medians 7073ms and 547ms; every post LCP exceeds the pre median. Root requests simultaneously fell 60 to 52 and transfer fell about 14.9KB, so the eager-prefetch removal worked and is not an evidence-backed cause. The comparison is confounded by four concurrent origin/main commits and host-load-sensitive timing. Next: run a quiet-host three-run control on synchronized origin/main and the branch, then use Linux CI traces/analyzer ownership to attribute only if the regression persists. Stop: do not undo the proven CLS/request fixes, raise budgets, or edit opaque chunks from timing alone.
